internal/sketch/check/authority.go	n.origin().Obj.Pkg.Path == std.PreludePath	Ambient host authority; follow-up declared contracts
internal/sketch/check/authority.go	obj.Pkg.Path == std.PreludePath	Task ownership; predeclared language type

internal/sketch/check/call.go	f.Pkg.Path == std.PreludePath	Unreachable; predeclared language function
internal/sketch/check/clausefix.go	p.Path == "go"	go.Foreign spelling in a written clause: the universe's go package, not a std identity
internal/sketch/check/contextvalues.go	n.Obj.Pkg.Path != std.PreludePath	Context predeclared row value
internal/sketch/check/decl.go	c.pkg.Path == std.PreludePath	prelude ownership declarations
internal/sketch/check/embed.go	n.Obj.Pkg.Path == "embed"	embedded assets; predeclared language operation
internal/sketch/check/entry.go	tn.Pkg.Path == "machines"	machines.Every timer (FKG1; NP3b removed workPath); follow-up declared contracts
internal/sketch/check/export.go	s.pkgs[i].Path != segmentPackage(s.segs[i].path)	snapshot integrity: a decoded segment is the package its header names, not a std identity
internal/sketch/check/export.go	segmentPackage(keys[i]) != pkg.Path	snapshot integrity: a module segment's key names its package, not a std identity
internal/sketch/check/extern.go	f.Pkg.Path == std.PreludePath	predeclared function footprint
internal/sketch/check/footprint.go	f.Pkg.Path != std.PreludePath	predeclared collection functions; follow-up declared contracts
internal/sketch/check/laws.go	pkg.Path != std.PreludePath	prelude provider selection
internal/sketch/check/loops.go	tn.Pkg.Path != std.PreludePath	Range predeclared iteration form
internal/sketch/check/mappedtext.go	n.Obj.Pkg.Path == "fs"	fs.Text and fs.Mapped, the mapped text borrow (types.md, Borrows 8); follow-up a declared borrow contract
internal/sketch/check/mappedtext.go	c.pkg.Path == "fs"	std fs declares Mapped.Text's fs.Text result (Borrows 8)
internal/sketch/check/match.go	o.Pkg.Path != std.PreludePath	Decision predeclared machine result
internal/sketch/check/ownership.go	o.Pkg.Path == "queue"	owned queue elements; follow-up declared contracts
internal/sketch/check/script.go	n.Obj.Pkg.Path != "testing"	derived Script; follow-up declared contracts
internal/sketch/check/withown.go	n.Obj.Pkg.Path == c.pkg.Path	with release seed: this package's types are named again in the second check, not a std identity
internal/sketch/check/withown.go	call.Func.Pkg.Path == "scope"	OnExit ownership; follow-up declared contracts
